snippet.title: Kuromaku | Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The first-ever teaser trailer for Kuromaku is finally here.

Kuromaku is a slow-burn psychological horror experience inspired by 1990s VHS aesthetics, focusing on atmosphere, narrative, and unsettling realism. What begins as ordinary life slowly unravels into something deeply disturbing.

This teaser offers a first glimpse into the world of the full game.

Wishlist now on Steam.
– BabGamesStudio
